label: input u at original positions 3-7
explanation: Token-and-position feature: fires only when the input token is u during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at positions 3 through 7. It almost always fires there (dev recall 0.997, precision 1.0). It never fires on u at positions 0-2, almost never at position 8 (177 activations), and never on any other token, on <DEL>, or in the copy phase (including when u is fed back as an output). Magnitude rises with position: roughly 0.3 of max at t=3, 0.65 at t=4, and near max at t=5. A repeated u in the same sequence fires more weakly than the first u (e.g. 0.45 vs 0.97). Context tokens (prev_tok, first_tok, L) have no meaningful effect.

issues: The binary predicate holds up. Test: precision 1.0, recall 0.997, F1 0.998, mass recall 0.9998, 0 false positives. All 172 test misses are tiny activations (0.02-0.06 of max) on u at t=8, holding 0.0% of the mass. That is scattered noise, not a systematic gap.
The claims of no firing in the copy phase, on <DEL>, on tokens other than u, or at t=0-2 are confirmed by the dev profile: copy-phase, delimiter-phase and non-u activity are all 0.

The magnitude claim 'near max from t=5 on' is false. Mean magnitude per active step (mass share / active count, arbitrary units, dev): t=3 0.92, t=4 2.17, t=5 2.64, t=6 2.29, t=7 1.10. It peaks at t=5 and falls at t=7 to about the t=3 level. Every top-activating example is at t=5. One example: 'o f z q o l e [u:0.31] g' is a first u at t=7 with activation 0.31. Relative magnitude (mass_recall/recall) for a first-occurrence u at t=7 is 0.61, against 1.47 at t=5.

The claim that a repeated u fires more weakly than the first u is confounded by position. The example given (0.97 vs 0.45) is a u at t=5 versus a u at t=7. Holding t=5 fixed, relative magnitude is 1.465 for a first occurrence and 1.461 for a repeat, so there is no repeat effect. The lowest-quartile example '1 1 2 [u:0.28] [u:0.68]' even has the repeated u firing more strongly, because it sits later (t=4 vs t=3).

The label is fine and matches the predicate. The explanation's magnitude story should read: activation ramps up from t=3 to a peak at t=5, then falls off at t=6-7, with only a trace at t=8. Whether u is a repeat does not matter.
